# Salaf

> Salaf is a public platform for accessing beneficial Islamic knowledge and resources.

## Public resources

- Home: /
- Explore: /explore
- Islamic lectures and videos: /videos
- Audio lessons: /audio
- Articles: /articles
- Public gallery: /gallery
- Support and public campaigns: /donate
- Privacy policy: /privacy-policy
- Terms of service: /terms-of-service

## Discovery and access

The canonical public discovery feed is `/sitemap.xml`. Crawl directives are available at `/robots.txt`. Article detail URLs use the format `/articles/{article-id}` when an article is publicly available. Dynamic records are sourced from the application’s public Firestore content and should not be inferred when unavailable.

## Restricted resources

Profiles, notifications, user questions, administration, authentication, and user-generated private data are restricted and are not public crawl targets.
